description: Derive advisory test-placement findings across audited projects while preserving project identity, from a project-audits/v1 artifact or, with repoRoot, from a fresh audit. Use analyze_test_placement for one project. Does not execute tests or create, move, or modify files.

changedPaths.description: Optional repository-relative source paths to limit target selection.

excludeProjectRoots.description: Optional project roots or subtree patterns such as examples/** to exclude before auditing.

goarch.description: Explicit GOARCH for bounded Go build-constraint evaluation.

goos.description: Explicit GOOS for bounded Go build-constraint evaluation.

tags.description: Optional custom Go build tags passed to the target-aware verification command.

projectAudits.description: A project-audits/v1 artifact; or pass repoRoot instead.

repoRoot.description: Repository root to audit instead of passing projectAudits.

swiftSchemes.description: Optional shared Xcode scheme per Swift project root. Keys are detected project roots.

name: analyze_project_test_placement

outputSchema.description: Top-level shape of this artifact. The complete contract is schemas/test-placement-findings-v1.schema.json in the published package.

title: Analyze Project Test Placement
